text:
jonah: Anyone else seeing NVLink disappear on mixed H100/A100 nodes in us-west2 during burst infer jobs?

infra-bot: ALERT nvlink_fallback_rate spike on cluster-prod-us-west2 (rolling 5m)

sandeep: yep, noticed ~2h ago. NCCL logs show repeated probe timeouts, then NET fallback.

marie: confirmed. We’re seeing socket bandwidth jump ~3x and tail latency spikes for several customers. cost impact visible in the billing dashboard. :grimacing:

kevin: impact scope: about 14 nodes in the h100 pool (mixed-sku racks) — autoscaler already spinning up extra A100 nodes to keep capacity.

olga: timeline: kernel 6.5.3 rollout started ~3h ago in us-west2 canary. Any overlap?

jonah: we rolled kernel 6.5.3 -> 6.5.3-rc1 to 40% of the fleet starting 3:15 PDT. The nodes that flipped to NET fallback line up with that window.

sandeep: paste of dmesg around the failure (trimmed):
```
[  123.456789] nvlink_probe: probe timeout on GPU 0: nvlink not responding
[  123.457001] nvlink: link down, falling back to p2p via socket
[  123.457210] nvidia: ucDashboard: failed to bring up nvlink for 0000:3b:00.0
```

sandeep: and quick `nvidia-smi topo -m` from an affected node shows NVLink rows missing between GPU0/1: 
```
        GPU0    GPU1    CPU
GPU0     X     SYS     24
GPU1    SYS      X     24
```

marie: NCCL debug shows: `NCCL WARN AllGather: p2p not available, using socket transport` repeatedly.

kevin: short-term mitigation options: 1) pin affected nodes to previous kernel in the pool 2) set NCCL envs to prefer p2p if available and reduce batching to reduce probe pressure 3) throttle canary rollout.

olga: opened INF-4823 and added logs + node list: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4823 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jonah: @oncall can we pause the kernel rollout in us-west2 and roll back the 40% subset? Need to contain cost impact.

sandeep: also reached out to driver vendor with kernel trace and nv-hostengine logs. They asked for `modprobe nvlink debug=1` on one repro node.

marie: tracking customer-facing impact: two prod teams reported increased 99p latency. I’ll flag CS and provide mitigation notes.

kevin: added temporary alert: high_nvlink_socket_fallback_rate -> paging oncall if >5% for 10m.

jonah: running a small rollback on 8 flagged nodes now, will update when they’re back to 6.4.x kernel.

infra-bot: TASK CREATED INF-4823:nvlink-investigation: assigned -> sandeep

sandeep: repro steps for triage (quick):
1) schedule a burst infer job pinned to mixed-sku rack
2) run `nccl-tests/all_reduce` with --nthreads 8 --iters 100
3) watch `dmesg | grep nvlink` and `nvidia-smi topo -m`

olga: also note: the failures are noisy under burst traffic patterns; low steady-state load doesn't trigger it. Could be a timing/regression in nvlink probe code under kernel change.

jonah: thanks — if rollback fixes it we’ll gate the rest of the rollout. Keep updates here and tag INC if customer impact grows. :thumbsup:
